policy_note: larql-core is a wave-1 crate (per the leaf-first no_std segregation plan): its one OS-coupled dependency, reqwest, already sits entirely behind the optional `http` feature (part of `default = ["http", "msgpack"]`), so `cargo check --no-default-features` already drops it today -- this is the one crate in the plausible set that needed no NEW feature-gating work at the dependency layer. It is still expected-fail on every target below for the same reason as the wave-0 leaves: `#![cfg_attr(not(feature = "std"), no_std)]` has not been added at the crate root yet. The no-default-features flag this workflow already passes for larql-core (see target-matrix.yml) stays in place once the crate root opt-out lands -- msgpack's rmp-serde is not OS-coupled and is not being asked to go away here. Promote a target's entry to expected-pass only as part of the PR that adds the no_std opt-out.
